headline: Capacity Constraints, Premiumization Prevails

highlights: With premium motorcycles growth continuing in the domestic market RE has been maintaining dominance in the middle-weight segment.

With new launches/ refreshes, brand building campaigns, allied revenue, multiple cost levers, pricing power and expanding international business it remains one of the resilient names in the motorcycle segment.
VECV has also been showing broad based growth and resilient margins amid supply chain challenges.
We estimate RE volume/realization CAGR of 11.6%/2.7% over FY26- 29E, translating to revenue/EBITDA/APAT CAGR of 15.3%/17.1%/15.6%.

With new launches/ refreshes, brand building campaigns, allied revenue, multiple cost levers, pricing power and expanding international business it remains one of the resilient names in the motorcycle segment.
We value the core business at a P/E of 31x (previous 30x) basis Sep’28E standalone EPS and VECV business at 10x EV/EBITDA Sep’28E.
